name: bank_build
about: our own tippable bank on one pivot at the front-bottom edge
code:
def bank_build(name='obank', y=178.0):
    piv = empty(name + '_piv', (0, y - 7, 0))
    wh = mat('bank_white', hexc('#f4f1ea'), 0.6)
    gd = mat('bank_gold', hexc('#e2b23a'), 0.35, metal=0.6)
    box(name + '_steps', (24, 4, 1.5), (0, -2, 0.75), wh, 0.05, parent=piv)
    box(name + '_body', (36, 14, 20), (0, 7, 11.5), wh, 0.1, parent=piv)
    box(name + '_band', (37, 15, 1.6), (0, 7, 22.2), gd, 0.05, parent=piv)
    for i in range(6):
        cyl(name + '_c%d' % i, 0.9, 18, (-12.5 + i * 5, -0.6, 10.5), wh, 16, parent=piv)
    box(name + '_ped', (30, 3, 4), (0, 1, 25), wh, 0.05, parent=piv)
    text(name + '_txt', 'BANK', (0, -0.8, 21.0), 3.0, gd, rot=(90, 0, 0), parent=piv)
    return piv
